title: Curves on irrational ruled surfaces whose complements are of non-general type
summary: Let $B$ be a curve on an irrational ruled surface $X$. We prove that the logarithmic Kodaira dimension of $X-B$ equals the Iitaka dimension of $K_X+B$ and give a rough configuration of $B$ when the logarithmic Kodaira dimension of $X - B$ is less than two. Next, we study the logarithmic multicanonical system of $X-B$ when the logarithmic Kodaira dimension of $X - B$ equals one and prove that its logarithmic $m$-canonical system gives either a $\mathbb{P}^1$-fibration or an elliptic fibration if $m \geq 12$.
